text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> service=inference-autoscaler, alert=queue_backlog_high, severity=page
pagerduty: Page routed to eng-oncall, escalation policy=primary->secondary
sam: Oncall here, acknowledging. what's the current backlog?
deepa: queue depth ~1,280 for inference-cell-7, processing lag ~65s, p95 latency 4.2s, p99 ~12.7s :frowning:
frances: confirmed. autoscaler hasn't provisioned new nodes in the last 8m, scale-controller heartbeat missing in logs
sam: trying manual intervention: `kubectl scale deployment/inference-cell-7 --replicas=+4`
ops-runner: initiated manual spinup via infra-runner, starting 2 new nodes (nodepool=hotpath-2), watching for kube events
morgan: temporarily routing low-priority traffic to dedicated-pool-d1 to relieve the hot cell
deepa: scale-controller logs show repeated provider 429s: `quotaExceeded` during instance create, reconcile loop backing off
sam: pinging infra team and quota owners. @frances can you escalate to infra-ops and cloud-quota?
frances: pinged infra-ops, they confirm cloud API rate limiting; requesting short-term quota bump and allowing preemptible fallback
incident-bot: Update: autoscaler heartbeat briefly resumed at +3m then dropped again, 3 scale-controller pods restarted
morgan: found one noisy client key (client=cli-42) producing bursty retry traffic, applying per-key rate-limit to reduce fanout
sam: applying rate-limit rule now for key=cli-42 (throttle to 5rps) :white_check_mark:
deepa: backlog dropping: 1280 -> 430 in 6m after manual spinup + client throttling
frances: KV cache warmup is slow; recommend temporary disable of prefix caching on inference-cell-7 to reduce fanout overhead
sam: disabling prefix cache for inference-cell-7 for 10m via feature-flag toggle, executing now
ops-runner: cache toggle applied, nodes are reporting healthy, queue now ~120 and draining normally
morgan: customer impact assessment: ~0.9% of requests experienced degraded latency or timeouts during the 15m spike; small number of customers retried causing backpressure. CS/Support notified
sam: creating follow-up INC ticket INC-2026-1787654322 with timeline and mitigation steps, assigning to eng-infra for quota root cause
morgan: taking handoff for monitoring window. will escalate immediately if queue >500 or p99>10s
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page resolved by sam, severity lowered to follow-up. post-incident review scheduled
